note: PAPER ONLY. Squad 16 (published winning methods, wide sweep) recording forward from 26 Oct 2026. Nothing here is a buy by itself: a rule needs a qualifying frozen 5-year verdict in BOTH halves (data/squad16-lab.json firstRun), incl. its portfolio test. Baskets change only at their review dates (quarterly: end of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec; MSCIQ: end of May/Nov; IND12: every month end). Halal = the owner's ZAD mark; "unknown" must be checked before any real buy.

SQ16-MAGIC.name: Greenblatt magic formula (EBIT/EV + return on capital, 1000 largest, 10 a quarter, each held a year)
SQ16-MAGIC.holdRule: buy the next open; hold one year (sold at the review four quarters later unless re-picked)

SQ16-ACQM.name: Carlisle Acquirer's Multiple (30 cheapest by EV / EBIT among the 1000 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-ACQM.holdRule: buy the next open; hold while the quarterly review keeps it selected

SQ16-QVAL.name: Gray & Carlisle Quantitative Value (cheapest 10% by EV/EBIT, then the better half by Piotroski F-score, quarterly)
SQ16-QVAL.holdRule: buy the next open; hold while the quarterly review keeps it selected

SQ16-GPVAL.name: Novy-Marx profitable value (gross profit / assets rank + book / market rank, 50 of the 500 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-GPVAL.holdRule: buy the next open; hold while the quarterly review keeps it selected

SQ16-MSCIQ.name: MSCI USA Quality method (iShares QUAL): ROE, low debt, stable earnings; 125 of the 600 largest, May/November, index-weighted
SQ16-MSCIQ.holdRule: buy the next open; hold while the semiannual review keeps it selected

SQ16-SHYLD.name: Meb Faber shareholder yield (dividends + net buybacks + debt paydown, top 100 of the 1000 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-SHYLD.holdRule: buy the next open; hold while the quarterly review keeps it selected

SQ16-VALMOM.name: AQR value + momentum combined (book/market rank + 12-1 momentum rank, 100 of the 1000 largest, quarterly)
SQ16-VALMOM.holdRule: buy the next open; hold while the quarterly review keeps it selected

SQ16-CORNER.name: O'Shaughnessy Cornerstone Growth (price/sales < 1.5, earnings up, top by 12-month price strength; each held a year)
SQ16-CORNER.holdRule: buy the next open; hold one year (sold at the review four quarters later unless re-picked)

SQ16-IND12.name: Industry momentum 12-0 among the 500 largest (top 5 SIC-2 industries by 12-month return, monthly)
SQ16-IND12.holdRule: buy the next open; hold while the monthly review keeps it selected
